title: Vitals Readout as Trigger Condition and Message

sections.what: New triggers and conditions for using vitals readout as a condition, and getting a vital readout as a message. Example: a thermostat that shows the character's core temperature, hunger, conditions, etc.

acceptance.text: Condition checks emit descriptive failure messages when vitals requirements are unmet.
Player receives clear feedback regarding blocked actions.

custom.idea: New triggers and conditions for using vitals readout as a condition, and getting a vital readout as a message. Example: a thermostat that shows the character's core temperature, hunger, conditions, etc.
custom.notes:
- The condition half already exists: `vital`, `vital_above`, `vital_below`, `temperature_above/below`, `area_temp` are implemented in `engine/trigger_system.py`.
- What's missing is the readout-as-message half: a message template placeholder (e.g. `{vital:Thirst}`) so an item's `message` effect can print a current vital value.
- Small completion of the existing system - no new condition machinery needed.
